nodes.name: HTTP Request – Download Receipt
nodes.notes: Downloads receipt file from URL when provided

nodes.name: HTTP Request – OCR
nodes.notes:
OCR_API_URL env var should point to your OCR endpoint
OCR_API_KEY should be set in HTTP Header credentials

nodes.name: HTTP Request – LLM Parse Receipt Items
nodes.notes:
LLM_API_URL: Your LLM endpoint (OpenAI/Anthropic/etc)
LLM_API_KEY: Set in HTTP Header credentials
LLM_MODEL: Optional model override

nodes.name: Google Sheets – Get User Profile
nodes.notes:
GOOGLE_SHEET_ID: Your Google Sheets document ID
Sheet 'Users' should have columns: user_id, dietary_preferences, cooking_skill, max_prep_time_minutes, household_size, notes

nodes.name: IF – Tier Logic
nodes.notes:
Extensibility point for tier-based features:
- basic: standard meal plan
- plus: enhanced features (more snacks, detailed instructions)
- coach: mark for nutritionist review

nodes.name: HTTP Request – LLM Generate Meal Plan
Google Sheets – Save Meal Plan
nodes.notes: Sheet 'MealPlans' should have columns: timestamp, user_id, plan_tier, week_label, plan_json, summary_text

nodes.name: Google Sheets – Log Error
nodes.notes: Optional: Sheet 'Errors' with columns: timestamp, error_type, message
